license_declaration.open_game_content: OGL 1.0a; the book's own OGL Section 15 notice (docs/governance/license-matrix.md, Starfinder rows)

operator_sign_off.note: Set true only after an operator has reviewed this book's classification (license-matrix.md: operator_sign_off false).

redaction_policy.description_pi: pi_field description; the sheet-rule converter prints none of it
redaction_policy.name_pi: renamed to codex_neutral_name::neutral_name of the row coordinate (a name cannot be redacted and still identify the record)
redaction_policy.screen: codex::rules_core::pi_screening::classify_field_sf on name, KEY and every DESC field, plus the row's NAMEISPI/DESCISPI declarations

screening_method_note: A bounded, case-sensitive substring scan against the Pathfinder blacklist and the Starfinder term set (E0.2), plus the corpus's own declared-PI tokens. It is not an exhaustive human legal review and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see.
